title: Multiple Choice - Closest in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: The young cellist displayed musical [genius] when she effortlessly improvised a complex classical piece without sheet music.
The company's chief architect was a true [visionary] who anticipated renewable energy trends decades ahead of competitors.
Completing a degree in astrophysics while working two night jobs was an [impressive achievement] for the young scholar.
The veteran statesman was widely [admired for] his fairness and unwavering commitment to global peace.
Many courageous patriots volunteered to fight in the [resistance war] to liberate their occupied homeland.
